tool_args.rationale: The five observations vary only u_now. Pilot signatures and authorized notes point to a flux-conserving, before-after epidemic mobility bridge, while the same observations can also be explained by snapshot response curves. The lowest-cost targeted open-branch probe is needed to distinguish these before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth present-snapshot model to the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows share the same past input, state, gradient, memory, and horizon, so they cannot identify the hinted two-layer mobility bridge or distinguish its temporal contrast from snapshot laws.
The current ambiguity is which mechanism applies, not insufficient sampling density along the same input sweep; this costs more than the targeted branch probe.
It is irrelevant to the stated mechanism ambiguity and explicitly unnecessary.
